sources.name: YouTube Help, Upload schedule tips for Shorts
supports: Creators should choose a consistent, sustainable schedule
Creators should consider time and monetary cost
Creators can batch Shorts and save drafts

sources.name: YouTube Help, Search and discovery tips for Shorts
supports: There is no minimum posting cadence required for Shorts to perform well
Recommendations match viewers with Shorts using performance and viewer personalization

sources.name: YouTube Help, Content tab analytics tips
supports: Shorts analytics include discovery and audience response measures such as shown in feed, views, likes, comments, subscribers, and watch time
